run_metadata.coverage_summary: Discovery this run was performed with web search only: the environment's egress policy blocked direct WebFetch to every tender portal (tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au, tenderlink, etc.), so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened and no deliverables/requirements pass was possible. Tier 1 government portals (NSW buy.nsw, Tenders WA, QTenders, SA/VIC/NT/ACT) were swept via search; university e-tendering (Adelaide, Sydney, UNSW, ANU) and GBE/utility procurement (Water Corporation WA, Southern Ports, water corporations) were checked; Tier 3 corporate was covered via SAP Ariba Discovery (login-gated) plus airport and head-contractor channels. All captured opportunities are recorded at headline level and flagged for a later authenticated/detail pass.
gaps: EGRESS BLOCKED: WebFetch to all tender portals was denied by the network egress proxy (tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au and others all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED). No tender detail page or attachment could be opened this run, so deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents and contacts could not be extracted from source. All entries are headline-level from search-result metadata only.

Identity/date fields for search-derived rows are taken from search-result summaries, not from the tender's own detail page; tender_id and closing_date on several rows still need confirmation against the portal once egress is available.
Buying for Victoria, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders and SA Tenders searches returned no confirmable newly-open rows via search this run (portal-side filtering needed).

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery opportunities are behind free supplier registration; no publicly-visible corporate RFx could be read. Recorded as a registration-gated portal, not fabricated as tenders.
Invitation-only corporate RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs to Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte-type panels) remain out of scope and undiscoverable, as expected.

tenders.notes: Registration-gated: individual package scopes are visible only to registered Felix vendors, so per-package detail could not be captured. Recorded as a real open EOI channel, not an invented tender.
